description: READ-ONLY. Vendor Central invoices (Vendor accounts only). Amazon SP-API has no read endpoint for retail vendor invoices (only submitInvoices), so this tool returns an explanation of the limitation and points to get_vendor_remittances for amounts estimated from purchase orders and to Vendor Central for the real invoices.

account_id.description: ID dell'outpost Amazon (= un seller su uno specifico marketplace; vedi list_clients). Opzionale se il token è legato a un solo outpost.

days_back.description: Quanti giorni indietro partire da oggi (intero, es. 30).

ship_from_party_id.description: Codice del magazzino di spedizione Vendor.

name: get_vendor_invoices
